title: HR Leave + Work Entry + Payroll Prep Chain
phase: Second-Pass Depth Closure — P2 Supporting Domains

key_findings.leave_state_machine: 5 states: confirm (default), validate1, validate, refuse, cancel. No draft state. confirm is entry point for all new requests.
key_findings.action_validate_flow: _action_validate writes state=validate then calls _validate_leave_request which calls _create_resource_leave creating resource.calendar.leaves. In hr_work_entry_holidays, _validate_leave_request override additionally calls _cancel_work_entry_conflict to create leave work entries and archive overlapping attendance entries.
key_findings.action_refuse_flow: action_refuse writes state=refuse and archives meeting. Resource calendar leave removal is handled by write() interceptor detecting validated_leaves with state change away from validate. hr_work_entry_holidays override also calls _regen_work_entries to archive leave WEs and recreate attendance WEs.
key_findings.work_entry_generation: Triggered by hr.employee.generate_work_entries or cron _cron_generate_missing_work_entries (daily, batches 100 versions per run, covers current+next month). Reads resource.calendar.leaves to split attendance intervals into attendance vs absence work entries.
key_findings.conflict_detection: SQL CTE in _mark_conflicting_work_entries: employee-date groups where SUM(duration) > 24 or <= 0 set to conflict state. Also: leaves outside schedule, already-validated days.
key_findings.hr_work_entry_type: Fields: code (payroll code used by salary rules), is_leave (Boolean, mutually exclusive with is_work), amount_rate (pay multiplier, default 1.0), external_code.
key_findings.hr_leave_type_fields: leave_validation_type (no_validation/hr/manager/both), requires_allocation (Boolean, default True), time_type (leave/other), request_unit (day/half_day/hour), work_entry_type_id (added by hr_work_entry_holidays).
key_findings.allocation_balance: hr.leave.allocation.leaves_taken computed from _get_consumed_leaves on employee; virtual_remaining_leaves = max_leaves - leaves_taken - virtual_leaves_taken. Each validated leave reduces available balance.
key_findings.community_payroll_boundary: hr_payroll absent from Community 19. work_entry state=validated ('In Payslip') is the Community-side payroll boundary. No hr.payslip, hr.salary.rule in Community.
